description: Find exported names that no module imports: dead exports with import-graph proof, per module and as a flat list.

modules.description: Modules in the set (at least one)

entry.description: True for entry modules: all their exports count as used public surface (optional, default false)

from.description: Path of the module imported from (must be one of the supplied modules)

names.description: Names imported from that module; an empty list is a side-effect import and uses no named exports (optional, default [])

name: find_dead_exports
